steps.label: unaccent
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa438_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa438_local,public; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent SCHEMA qa438_local; SELECT jsonb_build_object('dessert',unaccent('Crème brûlée'),'place',unaccent('Hôtel, déjà vu!'),'ligatures',unaccent('Æsir, Œuvre'),'unicode',unaccent('李'))::text; ROLLBACK;

steps.label: citext
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa438_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa438_local,public; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext SCHEMA qa438_local; CREATE TABLE stock(sku citext PRIMARY KEY,quantity integer NOT NULL); INSERT INTO stock VALUES('Widget-ALPHA',1); INSERT INTO stock VALUES('widget-alpha',2) ON CONFLICT(sku) DO UPDATE SET quantity=stock.quantity+EXCLUDED.quantity; CREATE TABLE plain(sku text PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO plain VALUES('Widget-ALPHA'),('widget-alpha'); SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(sku::text,quantity) ORDER BY sku) FROM stock),'case_insensitive',('Widget-ALPHA'::citext='widget-alpha'::citext),'text_case_sensitive',('Widget-ALPHA'::text='widget-alpha'::text),'plain_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM plain))::text; ROLLBACK;

steps.label: ltree
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa438_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa438_local,public; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ltree SCHEMA qa438_local; CREATE TABLE paths(id integer PRIMARY KEY,path ltree NOT NULL); INSERT INTO paths VALUES(1,'Top.Science.Astronomy'),(2,'Top.Science.Astronomy.Astrophysics'),(3,'Top.Hobbies.Amateurs_Astronomy'),(4,'Top.Collections.Pictures.Astronomy'),(5,'Top.Science.Chemistry'); CREATE INDEX paths_gist ON paths USING GIST(path); SET LOCAL enable_seqscan=off; SELECT jsonb_build_object('descendants',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM paths WHERE path <@ 'Top.Science'::ltree),'matches',(SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM paths WHERE path ~ '*.Astronomy.*'::lquery),'lca',lca('Top.Science.Astronomy'::ltree,'Top.Science.Astronomy.Astrophysics'::ltree)::text,'levels',nlevel('Top.Science.Astronomy.Astrophysics'::ltree),'prefix',subpath('Top.Science.Astronomy'::ltree,0,2)::text,'negative',(SELECT count(*) FROM paths WHERE path <@ 'Top.Unknown'::ltree))::text; EXPLAIN(ANALYZE TRUE,FORMAT JSON,COSTS OFF,TIMING OFF,SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM paths WHERE path <@ 'Top.Science'::ltree; ROLLBACK;

steps.label: pivot
command: BEGIN; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; CREATE SCHEMA qa438_local; SET LOCAL search_path=qa438_local,public; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS tablefunc SCHEMA qa438_local; CREATE TABLE sales(department text,quarter integer,amount numeric); INSERT INTO sales VALUES('books',1,12.50),('books',3,7.25),('games',2,19.99),('games',3,5.00); SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(department,q1::text,q2::text,q3::text,(coalesce(q1,0)+coalesce(q2,0)+coalesce(q3,0))::text) ORDER BY department))::text FROM crosstab('SELECT department,quarter,amount FROM qa438_local.sales ORDER BY 1,2','SELECT q FROM generate_series(1,3) q') AS ct(department text,q1 numeric,q2 numeric,q3 numeric); ROLLBACK;
